title: session-load's arm B replays kbmon --once without --shared, so it does not measure the shared snapshot the pane mod now uses
goal: bench_load's PANE_COMMANDS replays what the pane mod's refresh runs (kbmon.py --once --shared --max-age 55), so arm B measures the shared-snapshot saving

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import bench_load; print(bench_load.PANE_COMMANDS); sys.exit(0 if ("--once","--shared","--max-age","55") in bench_load.PANE_COMMANDS else 1)

gates.question: How does arm B keep the shared kbmon snapshot from serving the first measured pane run?
options: reset removes _cache/kbmon of the clone before each replay
warm_pane runs with --max-age 0 and nothing else changes
gates.recommendation: reset removes _cache/kbmon of the clone before each replay
gates.reason: the warm-up and the window before leave a snapshot under 55 s old that would serve the first run, which a new session's mod does not see
gates.answer: reset removes _cache/kbmon of the clone before each replay
